title: Multiple flood zones.
officialText:
For a structure that is located in more than one zone (for instance both an A-Zone and an X-Zone,
or both an A-Zone and a V-Zone), the provisions associated with the most restrictive area of special flood hazard shall apply to the
entire structure.
